Fixture required text in unresolved aligned result cells, which are intentionally empty. Added a unilateral insertion for actual result wrapping; conflict navigation checks source text.

Owned receiver still showed render feedback; sampled and terminated only its verified process group.

Automatic TextKit caret visibility overwrote the peer reading anchor.
Group-pending guard alone was insufficient. This diagnostic started before the preceding build had fully returned; final build/check were sequential.
All exact reading-position checks passed. Fixture incorrectly assumed a newly generated standalone merge was clean; it now checks the actual captured dirty/Undo baseline.
